name: rg_adapter_cold_v2
what: Bounded-residual MLP adapter steering BioEmu radius of gyration at one denoiser score call, trained at k = 1.
why_this_one: The cold arm at the paper's operating point: no direction prior at all, requesting a full sigma per unit level instead of half. k = 1 delivers twice the physical shift of v1 for no measurable loss of calibration quality (paired difference against k = 0.5: -4.62 points, CI [-9.61, +0.31], p = 0.069).

ablations_at_this_operating_point.note: Each is a strict one-line change from this configuration, paired against it on shared noise draws. Full tables in docs/steering/FINDINGS.md.
ablations_at_this_operating_point.level_conditioning_concat: -1.0% of k -- a cold-started concat adapter does not learn a dose response at all
ablations_at_this_operating_point.injection_site_ordinal_9: 89.6% of k but 17.11% of bonds in window against a 91.83% control, and fold metrics below the ensemble floor
ablations_at_this_operating_point.lambda_c_0: 64.5% of k, and the compress/expand ratio falls to 0.79
ablations_at_this_operating_point.lambda_g_0: 94.0% of k, null on both structure metrics -- the geometry penalty is inert at this site and dose

caveats: BioEmu approximates an equilibrium ensemble; do not infer free energies from steered samples.
Trained and evaluated on proteins of intermediate flexibility; behaviour outside that is untested.
One training run at one seed. Intervals are sequence-grouped bootstraps over held-out proteins and do not capture run-to-run training variance, which is unmeasured for this family.

This arm OVERSHOOTS: its held-out interval [1.0266, 1.1780] excludes k. The warm-started ablation reaches 95.0% with an interval that contains k, so on this single split the direction prior is the better-calibrated arm. Cold is shipped on the robustness argument established at k = 0.5 -- it was the only arm whose interval contained k on BOTH the filtered and unfiltered evaluation splits, while the warm arm swung 15.5 points and flipped from undershoot to overshoot between them. That two-split comparison has NOT been repeated at k = 1.

Compression saturates near 1.1 sigma. At k = 1 that ceiling is already reached, so requesting more compression than one sigma per level will not deliver it; expansion shows no ceiling within the range tested.
optimizer_state is emptied for release; adapter weights are bit-identical to the trained checkpoint.
